units.source_text: 萤兵部卿亲王是日在御前奏乐，然而神思恍惚，其心常萦绕在尚侍身边。

en.t: On that day Prince Hotaru, Minister of War, performed music before the Emperor, but his mind was in a daze, and his thoughts kept circling around the Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 后来忍耐不住，终于写封信去。

en.t: Later, unable to restrain himself any longer, he finally wrote and sent her a letter.

units.source_text: 恰巧此时髭黑大将赴近卫府公事室去了。

en.t: As it happened, General Higekuro had just gone to the offices of the Palace Guards on official business.

units.source_text: 使者将信交与侍女，说：“这是亲王吩咐送上的。”

en.t: The messenger handed the letter to a waiting woman and said, "His Highness ordered me to deliver this."
The waiting woman received the letter and presented it to the Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 玉鬘没精打采地启阅，但见信中写道：

en.t: Tamakazura opened and read it listlessly, and saw that the letter said:
